rounds.text: Stellant Securities is trading at an extraordinarily modest P/E of 10.9 despite explosive fundamental expansion, including a 5-year compounded sales growth of 220% and a trailing twelve-month sales surge of 1349% [E1, E9, E11]. Profitability metrics are exceptionally robust, featuring an ROE of 53.0% and an ROCE of 71.7%, vastly outperforming the sector median ROCE of 6.1% [E6, E7, E68]. The company operates entirely debt-free with zero borrowings, supported by strong sector tailwinds in Financial Services that carry a tailwind score of +0.83 [E31, E32, E65]. Valuation models indicate significant mispricing, as a reverse DCF suggests the current market price implies a negative earnings growth of -0.3%, while a forward discounted cash flow model places intrinsic value far above the trading price, offering a 73.5% margin of safety [E37, E38, E39]. Momentum is fully confirmed by a rules-based screen scoring 96 out of 100 alongside a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E43, E57]. Conceded: operating cash flow for March 2026 was negative at Rs -19 Cr, representing a cash conversion of -0.90x against reported profit [E27, E28].
